title: 第5章 搜刮战利品第6章 如何抉择
content_zh:
看来即便是在这宇宙海，储物戒指这样的东西，依旧是标配。
因为黑斗袍男子已经毙命，这储物戒指已是无主之物，所以林云轻易就能探查进去。
对于这里面的东西，林云十分好奇，一来此人来宇宙海，还不会有一些，祖地内没有的宝物、功法一类的东西？
二来，林云也渴望通过里面的东西或者情报，能够获取到更多关于宇宙海的消息、资料。
毕竟林云现在，对宇宙海还一无所知。
储物戒指内空间很大，东西果然有不少。
率先引起林云注意的，是一本《神力修炼法决》副本。
对于宇宙海的修炼方法和境界，林云现在是非常好奇的，所以林云迫不及待的拿出这本法决，打开查看。
神力修炼法决：
踏入神境之后，修为已达到一个全新层次，体内将拥有强大神力，想要在神境中提升修为，需吸收宇宙能量，通过神决转化为神力。
也可以通过吞噬神晶，或者吸收宇宙中一些特殊物质、资源，再由神决将这些能量，转化为神力。
看到这里，林云立刻就明白了其中的意思。
这跟在祖地使用皓月晶石提升修为，是一个道理。
毕竟修炼这种事，无论在什么样的世界，提升修为都是需要能量的。
“这黑斗袍人说我是一级神境，那么宇宙中所谓的神境，应该就等同于祖地的源境，只是叫法不同。”
林云心中暗自思索。
林云现在也终于明白，为什么自己达到源境之后，无法继续修炼了。
首先，祖地内并没有这样的神力修炼法决。
其次，修炼所需要的宇宙能量，亦或者法决中所说的神晶，以及宇宙中的一些特殊物质、资源，祖地内都没有。
在这种情况之下，林云如何去提升源境修为？

即便林云能自创出《神力修炼法决》这样的东西，可没有宇宙能量或者神晶，也是无济于事。
核心是要拥有能够提升神力的能量‘资源’。
所以踏入源境，在祖地就到天花板了。
“这家伙既然在宇宙海混，应该有神晶吧？”
林云想到这里后，立刻在他储物戒指内，寻找起来。
很快林云就找到了一堆透明晶体，数量大概有三千颗。
林云取出一枚，放在手中。
这些晶体，每一枚都只有拇指大，握在手心，林云明显能够感受到，它里面蕴含着一种特殊而又强大的能量。
“应该就是它了！”
这可是能够提升神境修为的东西，绝对是宝贝。
但林云无法立刻对他进行吸收，因为林云现在还没学习《神力修炼法决》，无法对其进行转化。
不过林云没急着立刻学习，而是打算先将储物戒指探查完。
储物戒指内，林云又发现了一块令牌。
令牌上面刻着‘星际探宝团’五个字。
content_en:
It seems that even in this cosmic sea, things like storage rings are still standard equipment.
Because the man in black robe was dead and the storage ring was ownerless, Lin Yun could easily detect it.
Lin Yun was very curious about the things inside. When this person came to the Universe Sea, would there be some treasures and techniques that were not found in the ancestral land?
Secondly, Lin Yun is also eager to obtain more news and information about the Cosmic Sea through the things or information inside.
After all, Lin Yun still knows nothing about the universe sea.
There is a lot of space inside the storage ring, and there are indeed a lot of things.
The first thing that caught Lin Yun's attention was a copy of "Magic for Cultivation of Divine Power".
Lin Yun was now very curious about the cultivation methods and realm of the Universe Sea, so Lin Yun couldn't wait to take out this magic book and open it to check.
Divine Power Cultivation Technique:
After entering the divine realm, your cultivation has reached a new level, and you will have powerful divine power in your body. If you want to improve your cultivation in the divine realm, you need to absorb the energy of the universe and convert it into divine power through divine arts.
You can also swallow divine crystals, or absorb some special materials and resources in the universe, and then use divine arts to convert these energies into divine power.
Seeing this, Lin Yun immediately understood the meaning.
This is the same as using bright moon crystals to improve cultivation in the ancestral land.
After all, practicing this kind of thing, no matter what kind of world you are in, improving your cultivation level requires energy.
"This man in black robe said that I am in the first-level divine realm, so the so-called divine realm in the universe should be equivalent to the origin realm of the ancestral land, but the name is different."
Lin Yun thought secretly in his heart.
Lin Yun now finally understood why he could no longer continue practicing after reaching the Source Realm.
First of all, there is no such method for cultivating divine power in the ancestral land.
Secondly, the cosmic energy required for cultivation, or the divine crystals mentioned in the law, as well as some special substances and resources in the universe, are not available in the ancestral land.
Under this situation, how can Lin Yun improve his cultivation in the Origin Realm?
Even if Lin Yun could create something like the "Divine Power Cultivation Technique" on his own, it would be useless without cosmic energy or divine crystals.
The core is to have energy ‘resources’ that can enhance divine power.
So when you step into the source realm, you reach the ceiling in the ancestral land.
"Since this guy is wandering in the universe, he should have a divine crystal, right?"
After Lin Yun thought of this, he immediately started looking for it in his storage ring.
Lin Yun soon found a pile of transparent crystals, about three thousand in number.
Lin Yun took out one and put it in his hand.
Each of these crystals was only as big as a thumb. Holding it in the palm of his hand, Lin Yun could clearly feel that it contained a special and powerful energy.
"This should be it!"
This is something that can improve your cultivation in the divine realm. It is definitely a treasure.
But Lin Yun could not absorb him immediately, because Lin Yun had not yet learned the "Divine Power Cultivation Technique" and could not transform it.
However, Lin Yun was not in a hurry to learn immediately, but planned to finish exploring the storage ring first.
Inside the storage ring, Lin Yun found another token.
The words "Interstellar Treasure Exploration Group" are engraved on the token.
